  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  Pattern classification [NPT_4147]  
  Marks: 50                                                                               Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           A biometric security system must identify individuals using fingerprints.  
  Analyze how different pattern recognition approaches (statistical vs. structural)  
  influence the accuracy and computational efficiency of fingerprint authentication.          (5)  
  A)      Explain which approach would be more suitable for large-scale systems and why.  
  
  B)      Given a dataset of handwritten digits, Illustrate feature extraction approach that captures  
  both structural and statistical features.                                                   (5)  
  
  2)           For a weather forecasting system, examine how Bayesian inference combines prior  
  probabilities and likelihood functions to classify complex weather patterns.  
  Analyze how updates in prior probabilities (e.g., seasonal trends) can influence            (5)  
  A)      classification outcomes and prediction reliability.  
  
  B)      A medical image classifier uses binary features (tumor present/absent). Illustrate how  
  Bayes Decision Theory applies to binary classification.                                     (5)  
  
  3)           A machine learning model predicts air pollution levels in a city.  
  Evaluate how maximum likelihood estimation (MLE) helps in identifying optimal  
  model parameters under noisy environmental data.                                            (5)  
  A)      Compare MLE with other estimation methods (e.g., least squares) in terms of  
  robustness and interpretability.  
  
  B)      You are designing a face recognition system that must differentiate between 10  
  people.Illustrate how Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) can be applied                     (5)  
  
  4)           A handwriting recognition system employs a simple neural network model.  
  Analyze how the perceptron criterion influences the formation of the decision  
  boundary between handwritten characters.                                                (5)  
  A)      Discuss the limitations of this approach in handling non-linear separability and how it  
  can be improved.  
  
  B)      A credit card fraud detection model applies a Hyperbox classifier. Illustrate how  
  hyperboxes define class boundaries in multi-dimensional data.                               (5)  
  
  5)           In a speech emotion recognition system, fuzzy logic is used to classify emotions such       (5)  
  as happy, sad, or angry.
